descrizione: A mature woman of about forty-five with a low, steady alto voice. She is the technical head of the company: dry, firm and authoritative, short sentences, measured pace, no theatrical emphasis. Clear standard Italian diction, no strong regional accent. Close-microphone studio recording, dry, no reverb, no music.
